competitorNotes: Merge conflict humor on Etsy is stickers, mugs and shirts ('I was sane a few merges ago', cat at a red merge screen); no posters surfaced.
Shirts at about $20-45 and stickers dominate; a wall print of the raw conflict markers is an open angle.
No merge-conflict prints on Amazon; git humor there is the 'in case of fire' poster.
Amazon programmer prints lead with the joke, then stack 'wall art', 'office decor', 'developer gift' and state 'unframed' plus size.

research.notes: 'merge conflict' is the recurring phrase in Etsy titles; the full 'merge conflict poster' is 21 characters, so the tag is 'merge conflict'. Git is named because the printed markers are Git's conflict format. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with framed prints, and no unframed physical prints with prices were comparable.
